diagnosis.hypothesis: Observed only user1 connectivity to networks behind leaf2 was failing, while other cross-subnet paths were healthy. Read user1 and leaf1 state/config and found leaf1 ethernet-1/1.0 had IPv4 enabled but no address, despite leaf1 static routes toward leaf2 using spine next-hops 10.255.0.0 and 10.255.0.2. Added 10.255.0.1/31 to leaf1 ethernet-1/1.0. Public success criteria then passed with all lab connectivity checks succeeding.
diagnosis.reference: On leaf1, interface ethernet-1/1 lost its IPv4 address: 10.255.0.1/31 was removed, so the interface has no address on the fabric_l1_s1 segment.

arguments.name: ethernet-1/1.0
arguments.reason: leaf1-user subnet can reach leaf1 locally, but all paths to networks behind leaf2 fail while healthy paths from other segments work. Evidence shows leaf1 static routes toward leaf2 use next-hops 10.255.0.0 and 10.255.0.2, yet leaf1 ethernet-1/1.0 had IPv4 enabled with no address, breaking one of its uplinks to spine1 and remote reachability for user1.

action.command: set / interface ethernet-1/1 subinterface 0 ipv4 address 10.255.0.1/31
